kind: production obligations, not observed test results

scenarios.name: No PR and no account
scenarios.procedure: Open an ordinary folder, module and individual file without authentication, initial diff or agent configuration. Add a note immediately.

scenarios.name: Dirty R0
scenarios.procedure: Start with tracked staged/unstaged and chosen untracked changes; inspect exact working bytes, distinguish index and commit, change nothing in the source tree.

scenarios.name: Scope is not deletion
scenarios.procedure: Capture a module within a larger repository, extend scope later, and prepare publication without deleting omitted files.

scenarios.name: Concurrent capture
scenarios.procedure: Writer changes several files during scan; demonstrate consistency classification, bounded retry/refusal, no false atomic snapshot claim.

scenarios.name: Root substitution
scenarios.procedure: Replace/move a root, link, parent or source file while capture is pending; enforce root/handle identity and explicit rebind.

scenarios.name: Representation edges
scenarios.procedure: CRLF, tabs, no-final-newline, Unicode, invalid text, binary, symlink mode and unsupported LFS/filters preserve exact evidence or fail explicitly.

scenarios.name: Repeated snippets
scenarios.procedure: Rename, move, copy and delete identical blocks across revisions; no nearest-line correspondence presented as certainty.

scenarios.name: Exact edit conflicts
scenarios.procedure: Test deletion/insertion, adjacent replacement, overlap and duplicate boundary insertion against the same original blob.

scenarios.name: Stale replacement
scenarios.procedure: Change unrelated bytes in the original file; exact apply requires revalidation, not a fuzzy match on the edited slice.

scenarios.name: Already applied and illustrative
scenarios.procedure: Deliver an illustrative snippet and an observed already-applied edit; neither is blindly applied as a proposed exact replacement.

scenarios.name: Native editing
scenarios.procedure: Virtual-space/multi-caret/box selection, clipboard, IME and undo preserve per-line intent, without moving source anchors or modifying the working tree.

scenarios.name: Freeze and re-share
scenarios.procedure: Share one round by copy, file, CLI and direct adapter; canonical content is identical and post-share edits are new revisions.

scenarios.name: No summarizer
scenarios.procedure: Prepare eight items/two suggestions with all model code absent; output preserves selected prose/context without a second prompt or lossy summary.

scenarios.name: Oversized assignment
scenarios.procedure: Exceed item/source/export bounds; display exact counts/limits and refuse silent truncation. Paged consumers assemble the same round before acting.

scenarios.name: Archive hostile members
scenarios.procedure: Traversal, drive/UNC, encoded traversal, duplicates, Unicode/case aliases, links, encrypted ZIP and expansion bomb refuse before admission.

scenarios.name: Private-context exclusion
scenarios.procedure: Unselected scratch notes, earlier replies, model logs, credentials and absolute local user paths are absent from all outgoing channels.

scenarios.name: Human callback-free iteration
scenarios.procedure: Give readable feedback to a human outside BPR, obtain source changes, capture R1 and compose F2 without JSON or completion protocol.

scenarios.name: Recipient claim versus verified
scenarios.procedure: Import addressed/disputed/blocked replies; none verifies feedback. Reviewer verification binds to observed material and later changes are explicit.

scenarios.name: Duplicate and forged report
scenarios.procedure: Replay identical report, alter its content under the same ID, change target/item revision and forge verified/model authority.

scenarios.name: Owner concurrent use
scenarios.procedure: Desktop and multiple terminal/harness sessions target explicit cycles/rounds; late completions and active tab changes cannot redirect reads/writes.

scenarios.name: Automation independently denied
scenarios.procedure: Remove automation while leaving GUI; manual copy/save/capture/compare still work. Revoke one read scope without changing other cycles.

scenarios.name: Actual adapter removal
scenarios.procedure: Install agent-free package, remove adapter mid-cycle, restart; no model discovery/network or lost notes/revisions and manual continuation works.

scenarios.name: Send uncertain
scenarios.procedure: Interrupt direct delivery after possible acceptance, then remove adapter; no automatic resend/fallback and capture is still available.

scenarios.name: Storage and pins
scenarios.procedure: Crash/fill disk/corrupt bytes during capture/freeze, prune with pinned histories and restore backup; no dangling success or silent retargeting.

scenarios.name: Initial work versus iteration
scenarios.procedure: Publish all selected finished work or iteration-only changes over explicit base; expose required initial dependencies and unrelated checkout edits.

scenarios.name: Isolated candidate
scenarios.procedure: Hash user index/refs/worktree before and after planning/candidate/publish; hooks/filters/signing unsupported paths execute nothing.

scenarios.name: Publication grant invalidation
scenarios.procedure: Change source/selection/base/head/title/body/identity after preview; the old finite grant cannot authorize the changed effects.

scenarios.name: Publication lost receipts
scenarios.procedure: Lose each blob/tree/commit/ref/PR response; read first, match exact planned identities, no duplicate PR or foreign object adoption.

scenarios.name: Server capability and drift
scenarios.procedure: Unsupported GHES/API/object format/permissions/branch rules and moved base/head produce honest limits or refreshed review; no raw-shell workaround.

scenarios.name: History after squash
scenarios.procedure: Create real PR from final result and revisit R0/R1/R2 and all private rounds. Only selected public description/comments leave BPR.

scenarios.name: Old PR compatibility
scenarios.procedure: Review ordinary PR/tour, including GitHub-only collaborator and mixed-client behavior; local cycle additions do not become shadow public authority.

scenarios.name: Accepted scaffold
scenarios.procedure: Width floors, folded Updates line, exact document pairs, comments tray, shortcuts, focus and owner attended review are measured natively.

scenarios.name: Large project
scenarios.procedure: Measure cold/warm capture and browsing on named 1M LOC / 100k file corpora; retain bounded interaction and report limits without hidden omissions.

scenarios.name: Context benefit
scenarios.procedure: Compare eight-item/two-suggestion round with manually assembled prompt on fixed code/task; measure preparation, steering and rework, not assumed token savings.

scenarios.name: External skill denied or absent
scenarios.procedure: CLI/skill unavailable or not permitted: readable handoff remains useful where policy allows, no guessed flags, SQL scrape or forced model install.

scenarios.name: Standalone source portability
scenarios.procedure: Read exported feedback on another machine without BPR, interpret exact bytes correctly, explicitly map project/source before association.
